import { chromium } from 'playwright'
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'

const BASE = process.env.E2E_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8095'
const OUT = 'artifacts/eval-mock'
mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true })

const browser = await chromium.launch()
const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 })
const page = await ctx.newPage()
page.setDefaultTimeout(15000)
page.on('pageerror', e => console.log('PAGEERROR:', e.message))

async function shot(name) { await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${name}.png`, fullPage: true, animations: 'disabled' }) }
async function bodyText() { return (await page.locator('body').innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ') }

const results = []

// 1. 记录列表（物业自查）
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/records/index?checkType=1`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(1500)
let t = await bodyText()
results.push(['列表-统计(检查记录128)', t.includes('128')])
results.push(['列表-待办任务(娄门路130号院落)', t.includes('娄门路130号院落')])
results.push(['列表-已完成(永林新村)', t.includes('永林新村')])
results.push(['列表-未整改徽章', t.includes('未整改')])
results.push(['列表-评分(82分)', t.includes('82分')])
await shot('01-records')

// 2. 发起检查：区域搜索
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/start/index?checkType=1`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(800)
await page.locator('input[aria-label="物业管理区域"]').click()
await page.locator('input[aria-label="物业管理区域"]').type('娄门')
await page.waitForTimeout(900)
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['发起-搜索弹出娄门路130号院落', t.includes('娄门路130号院落')])
// 选择第一个
const opt = page.locator('.complex-option').first()
if (await opt.count()) { await opt.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(700) }
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['发起-带出检查信息(检查频次)', t.includes('检查频次')])
results.push(['发起-评价等级(市标二级)', t.includes('市标二级')])
await shot('02-start')

// 3. 检查填写（待办任务 记录ID）
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/form/index?checkRecordId=2000000000000000001&checkType=1`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['填写-综合服务类别', t.includes('综合服务')])
results.push(['填写-检查项(项目备案与台账齐全)', t.includes('项目备案与台账齐全')])
results.push(['填写-打分选项(符合)', t.includes('符合')])
await shot('03-form')

// 4. 检查记录详情（已完成 记录ID 3000000000000000001）
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/detail/index?checkRecordId=3000000000000000001`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['详情-检查记录编号', t.includes('检查记录编号')])
results.push(['详情-评价得分82', t.includes('82')])
results.push(['详情-整改详情页签', t.includes('整改详情')])
results.push(['详情-整改项清单', t.includes('整改项清单')])
await shot('04-detail-check')

// 5. 整改通知书详情（noticeId）
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/rectify/index?noticeId=4000000000000000001`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['整改-整改进度', t.includes('整改进度')])
results.push(['整改-整改措施及说明', t.includes('整改措施及说明')])
results.push(['整改-反馈人字段', t.includes('反馈人')])
await shot('05-rectify')

// 6. 物业自查记录详情 - 整改详情页签（tab=rectify）

t = await bodyText()
results.push(['详情tab-整改项清单可见', t.includes('整改项清单')])
await shot('06-detail-rectify-tab')

await browser.close()

let fail = 0
for (const [name, ok] of results) { console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${name}`); if (!ok) fail++ }
console.log(`\n${results.length - fail}/${results.length} passed`)
process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0)

const OUT = 'artifacts/eval-mock'
mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true })

const browser = await chromium.launch()

const page = await ctx.newPage()
page.setDefaultTimeout(15000)
page.on('pageerror', e => console.log('PAGEERROR:', e.message))

async function shot(name) { await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUT}/${name}.png`, fullPage: true, animations: 'disabled' }) }
async function bodyText() { return (await page.locator('body').innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ') }

await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/records/index?checkType=1`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })

await page.locator('input[aria-label="物业管理区域"]').type('娄门')
await page.waitForTimeout(900)
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['发起-搜索弹出娄门路130号院落', t.includes('娄门路130号院落')])
const opt = page.locator('.complex-option').first()
if (await opt.count()) { await opt.click(); await page.waitForTimeout(700) }
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['发起-带出检查信息(检查频次)', t.includes('检查频次')])
results.push(['发起-评价等级(市标二级)', t.includes('市标二级')])

t = await bodyText()
results.push(['填写-综合服务类别', t.includes('综合服务')])
results.push(['填写-检查项(项目备案与台账齐全)', t.includes('项目备案与台账齐全')])
results.push(['填写-打分选项(符合)', t.includes('符合')])
await shot('03-form')

// 4. 检查记录详情（已完成 记录ID 3000000000000000001）
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/detail/index?checkRecordId=3000000000000000001`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['详情-检查记录编号', t.includes('检查记录编号')])
results.push(['详情-评价得分82', t.includes('82')])
results.push(['详情-整改详情页签', t.includes('整改详情')])
results.push(['详情-整改项清单', t.includes('整改项清单')])
await shot('04-detail-check')

// 5. 整改通知书详情（noticeId）
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#/pages/project-check/rectify/index?noticeId=4000000000000000001`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
t = await bodyText()
results.push(['整改-整改进度', t.includes('整改进度')])
results.push(['整改-整改措施及说明', t.includes('整改措施及说明')])
results.push(['整改-反馈人字段', t.includes('反馈人')])

t = await bodyText()
results.push(['详情tab-整改项清单可见', t.includes('整改项清单')])
await shot('06-detail-rectify-tab')

await browser.close()

for (const [name, ok] of results) { console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${name}`); if (!ok) fail++ }
console.log(`\n${results.length - fail}/${results.length} passed`)
process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0)
